column1: # Debloat decision registry - one row per id, one status per id.
# This is the single source of truth for 'is X safe?': the list files stay
# the APPLY/undo input, apply.sh keeps its runtime DENY, and
# tools/test_debloat.py asserts all three agree with this file.
#   evidence, date, source (list file / denylist / live audit), owner.
#   applied   disabled now; the list named in source undoes it
#   deferred  not applied; needs Home replacement or an owner decision
#   never     must not be disabled (breaks a kept feature) - apply.sh refuses
#   reverted  was disabled, then re-enabled (kept here with the reason)
#   rejected  considered and dropped; do not re-propose without new evidence
# Note: the sharing batch was 16 ids; com.samsung.tv.multiscreen is one of
# them and is recorded as deferred (tier2b) - one row per id.
